nodes.label: DatasetManager.remove_images()
nodes.rationale: Removing an image from a Dataset only mutates that Dataset's own independent Image pool (Mission 011 ownership model) — never Workspace.images, never the physical file, never another Dataset referencing the same file_path; no confirmation dialog, consistent with delete_dataset() already having none.

nodes.label: Gallery sort by file mtime (file_mtime_sort_key)
nodes.rationale: mtime chosen over a new Domain field (created_at) to avoid any Domain/serialization change or project.json migration; explicitly accepted trade-off that shutil.copy2() (used by copy_into_workspace) preserves source mtime, so sort-by-date reflects file modification time, not import time.

nodes.label: LoRA metadata fiche (LoRAManager.update()/set_thumbnail())
nodes.rationale: Deliberate asymmetry: LoRA.thumbnail is copied into the Workspace via copy_into_workspace() while LoRA.files stays external/uncopied, because the Blueprint documents LoRA model files as resources shared across Workspaces while a thumbnail is workspace-owned illustrative content.

nodes.label: Prompt Assistant mode selector (checkable QButtonGroup)
nodes.rationale: Native Qt :checked styling adopted over custom QSS, contingent on a real-render smoke test; setAutoDefault(False) added after discovering create_mode_button silently inherited the dialog's default-button styling, confusing it with the checked-mode indicator.

nodes.label: No open project vs no principal character warning distinction
nodes.norm_label: no open project vs no principal character warning distinction
nodes.rationale: principal_character returns None both when no Workspace is open and when a Workspace has no Character — Option A (direct WorkspaceManager injection into Pages) retained over Option C (a workspace_opened facade property on each Character-owned Manager) as the single source of authority belongs to WorkspaceManager, not to Character-owned Managers.

nodes.label: Prompt Assistant output contract (@@AISTUDIO_PROMPT_START/END@@)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic delimiter extraction with a strictly non-destructive fallback (response.strip() whenever the delimiter pair is malformed/absent/empty) — deliberately no heuristic Markdown/preamble stripping, to never lose a valid model response even when the model does not respect the contract.

nodes.label: CharacterManager.principal_character
nodes.rationale: active_character_id is reset to None on WORKSPACE_OPENED and never re-selected automatically once CharactersPage stopped calling select() (Mission 026); Character-owned Managers must resolve via principal_character (falls back to the first Character) rather than active_character to remain usable after a reopen without manual selection — propagated fix across DatasetManager (M028), LoRA/Prompt/TrainingManager (M029).

nodes.label: PromptsPage dirty-state + refresh categorization
nodes.rationale: Strict EventBus separation retained over a double-subscription design: update_prompts() handles non-destructive refreshes (WORKSPACE_SAVED/RENAMED, CHARACTER_CREATED, PROMPT_CREATED/SELECTED/DELETED) while reset_for_context_change() handles true context changes (WORKSPACE_CREATED/OPENED/CLOSED, CHARACTER_SELECTED/DELETED) — removes any dependency on EventBus subscriber ordering.

nodes.label: Prompts → Envoyer vers Inference
nodes.rationale: Signal Qt + MainWindow mediator (Option A) chosen over a new EventBus event: no Domain mutation occurs in this transfer, so inventing a pseudo-Domain event would misuse the existing 'domain.verb' EventBus contract; PromptsPage never imports InferencePage directly.

nodes.label: use_result_button re-enable after failed follow-up generation
nodes.norm_label: use_result_button re-enable after failed follow-up generation
nodes.rationale: Button state made a direct function of result_edit's current content (bool(text.strip())) rather than of the last generation attempt's success/failure, so a still-displayed valid prior result remains actionable after a subsequent failed retry.

nodes.label: WorkspaceManager.remove_images() / images_referenced_by_datasets() / preview_image_removal()
nodes.rationale: Atomic block-if-referenced-by-any-Dataset policy plus a mandatory, honest confirmation dialog classifying each selected image as 'to delete' (internal + present on disk) vs 'to remove only' (external or missing) — never presenting a missing file as if it were external, and never allowing silent/partial deletion.

nodes.label: WorkspaceManager.rename()
nodes.rationale: Commit-last transactional ordering: current_workspace is mutated only after both the physical folder rename and project.json save succeed, structurally eliminating the need to roll back a partially-mutated Domain object; on save failure a best-effort filesystem rollback is attempted, and any residual inconsistency is surfaced explicitly rather than silently swallowed.

nodes.label: WORKSPACE_SAVED refresh wiring pattern (no new EventBus subscription needed)
nodes.norm_label: workspace_saved refresh wiring pattern (no new eventbus subscription needed)
nodes.rationale: Because every mutating Manager method already calls WorkspaceManager.save() (publishing WORKSPACE_SAVED) before publishing its own domain event, any Page already subscribed to WORKSPACE_SAVED is automatically refreshed — verified explicitly rather than assumed, and reused identically across Missions 043, 044, 045, 046.

nodes.label: WorkspaceStorage.copy_into_workspace() / is_inside()
nodes.rationale: A source already resolving inside workspace_root is returned as-is without copying (no shutil.copy2, no rename) — this single short-circuit avoids duplicating Inference/Accept outputs and later becomes the reusable guard for cross-Dataset reuse (M044), thumbnail placement (M047) and the last-line-of-defense before any physical delete (M046).
